set.body: PROPOSAL under codec bead bd-01M14K855QC1VB6H17S4W9FCS2. Current SM4SFT01 checksum proves only a complete file fetch. Novel-scale Atlas range loading needs one sidecar per load tile or a versioned block table with per-block content receipts so a row range can be authenticated without downloading the monolith. Scope later: choose tile vs block contract with storyatlas4s; preserve SidecarTrack logical missingness; version the byte layout/magic; checked row-to-block offsets; corruption and wrong-block proofs; JVM/JS/Native laws. Do not build in slice 2; no privacy claim until keyed sensitive receipts land.
set.title: codec follow-up: tiled sidecars and block integrity for Atlas range loading
